items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: He played with Sidney Desby and also Celestine. When Celestine had a big man.

ctx.x: He played with Sidney Desby and also Celestine. When Celestine had a big man. Yes. He's dead also. Now these fellas, I don't know who they are. Yeah.
A couple more, three more cornets.
